title: 第24章 镇岳功第25章 第三次刑使任务
slug: 镇守仙秦地牢吞妖六十年
content_zh:
典籍司，存放镇抚司中各种典籍之地。
其中既有各种镇抚司处理案件的绝密卷宗，也有许多武道修行之法的典籍密录。
甚至据说还收录了许多江湖门派，乃至于仙道和儒道的典籍。
典籍司中所存的书册密录要想翻阅，要么是持镇抚司中司首手令，要么是有足够的官职和军功。
仙秦重军功，对于功勋的奖励和厚待无以复加。
张远来到典籍司，将玉牌拿出。
“司首玉令，可翻阅庐阳府镇抚司的所有修行典籍，任选其中一门修行。”
接过玉牌的中年文士目光扫过，面上闪过一丝惊异。
这玉牌他在庐阳府镇抚司只见过两次。
悄然打量一下张远，文士抬手示意张远与他一起往典籍司中那一排排库房走去。
“仙秦武道功法以天地人三阶划分，每一阶又分为九品，天阶功法只藏于皇城，极少外传。”
“江湖和军伍，以及镇抚司中的武道功法，最上乘就是地阶九品。”
“其实我仙秦陛下并不禁绝武道修行，皇城大殿之外的广场上九鼎便篆刻天品功法，谁都可以观阅。”
文士一边走，一边为张远介绍武道修行和镇抚司中所藏典籍。
武道修行重熬炼，重天赋。
熬炼可以是苦修与资源堆积，天赋则是对修行之道的领悟。
天赋不够，资源底蕴不够，天品武道就算放在面前也无法修行。
皇城九鼎上的修行法，没有开阳之上的境界，别说看不懂，就算是看得懂也修不成。
至于担心那等功法外传，那更是没必要。
世间武道最强传承在仙秦，世间资源最丰厚在仙秦，世间武道最强者也在仙秦。

只要你足够强，只要你还想更强，最终还是会为仙秦所用。
若不然，等待的就是毁灭。
张远也曾憧憬过九鼎上的天品功法。
可皇城在哪？
仙秦九洲，庐阳府只是九洲之一腾洲的一方府城之地。
庐阳府归属于郑阳郡。
从庐阳府往皇城，便是手上有通关文牒，一路畅通，也需要一年半载。
何况江湖路远，寻常人可能一辈子都走不到皇城。
“年轻人，不要好高骛远，选功法要契合自身修行。”
“当然，这司首玉令珍贵，也不能浪费大好机会，其中平衡你自己酌量。”
“选好功法就直接去二楼寻供奉讲解。”
中年文士站在一道青铜门庭之前，伸手推开门，然后看向张远开口。
扑面的书卷气息夹杂着一丝燥热透出。
张远拱手，走进门庭。
入眼的是一排排书架，其上的书册或是摊开，或是卷轴。
书架上也有木牌，标明了拳法或者刀剑武技，不但如此，还有功法等级标注。
比如张远就在人阶三品的拳法位置发现了铁甲拳拳谱。
铁甲拳的拳谱就薄薄几页，其上除了图谱还有一些文字注释，翻阅一下，感觉跟自己所修没有区别，其中文字注释还没有曹正堂讲解精细。
铁甲拳拳谱旁边放着一些同层次的拳法，其中既有仙秦军伍和镇抚司流传的拳法，也有江湖拳法。
翻阅看看，江湖拳法开篇大多说的高深莫测，什么“此拳修成可镇山河”，什么“凭此功法能横行万里”，什么“吾修行一甲子方悟此法，传于后人”……

军伍和镇抚司的功法就没有那些花哨，只记录“此法乃镇抚司十二武道基础正法之一”，“仙秦三万一千五百三十年，云貘将军韩兆创此拳”等等讯息。
好不容易得到的选取功法机会，张远不可能浪费在人阶功法上。
他径直去循着木牌，看到地阶功法的位置。
content_en:
The Classics Department is the place where various classics in the Zhenfu Department are stored.
Among them are top-secret files on various cases handled by the Zhenfu Division, as well as many secret records on martial arts practice.
It is even said to have included classics from many Jianghu sects, as well as immortal Taoism and Confucianism.
If you want to read the secret records stored in the Classics Department, you must either have a warrant from the head of the Zhenfu Department, or you must have sufficient official positions and military merits.
Xian Qin places great emphasis on military merit, and the rewards and favors for meritorious deeds are endless.
Zhang Yuan came to the Classics Department and took out the jade tablet.
"Sishou Yuling, you can read all the spiritual practice books of Luyang Prefecture Zhenfusi and choose any one of them to practice."
The middle-aged scribe who took the jade token glanced at it, a trace of surprise flashing across his face.
He had only seen this jade plaque twice in Fusi, Luyang Prefecture.
After quietly sizing up Zhang Yuan, the scribe raised his hand and motioned for Zhang Yuan to walk with him to the rows of warehouses in the Classics Department.
"The Immortal Qin martial arts skills are divided into three levels of heaven, earth and human beings, and each level is divided into nine levels. The heaven level skills are only hidden in the imperial city and are rarely spread outside."
"The best martial arts skills in the Jianghu, military, and Zhenfu divisions are those of the ninth rank of the Earth Rank."
"Actually, my Majesty, Immortal Qin, does not prohibit the practice of martial arts. On the square outside the Imperial City Hall, there are nine cauldrons inscribed with Heavenly Grade Kung Fu, and anyone can watch them."
As the scribe walked, he introduced Zhang Yuan to martial arts practice and the classics collected in Zhenfu Division.
Martial arts practice emphasizes training and talent.
Refining can be hard work and accumulation of resources, while talent can be the understanding of the way to practice.
If you don't have enough talent and resources, you won't be able to practice the heavenly martial arts even if you put them in front of you.
The cultivation method on the Nine Cauldrons of the Imperial City does not have a realm above Kaiyang. Let alone not understanding it, even if one understands it, one cannot practice it.
As for worrying about the external spread of such techniques, there is no need.
The strongest inheritance of martial arts in the world is in Xian Qin, the richest resources in the world are in Xian Qin, and the strongest martial arts in the world are also in Xian Qin.
As long as you are strong enough, as long as you want to be stronger, you will eventually be used by Xian Qin.
Otherwise, destruction awaits.
Zhang Yuan had also longed for the heavenly skills on the Jiuding.
But where is the imperial city?
In the Immortal Qin Nine Continents, Luyang Mansion is just one side of Tengzhou, one of the Nine Continents.
Luyang Prefecture belongs to Zhengyang County.
It would take a year and a half to go from Luyang Mansion to the Imperial City, even if the customs clearance documents were in hand, and the journey would be smooth.
What's more, the road to Jianghu is far away, and ordinary people may not be able to reach the imperial city in their lifetime.
"Young people, don't be too ambitious. Choose exercises that suit your own practice."
"Of course, this chief jade order is precious, and you cannot waste this great opportunity. You must decide the balance yourself."
"After choosing the exercises, go directly to the second floor to find an explanation."
The middle-aged scribe stood in front of a bronze door, stretched out his hand to open the door, then looked at Zhang Yuan and spoke.
The smell of books on the face was mixed with a hint of heat.
Zhang Yuan cupped his hands and walked into the courtyard.
What catches the eye are rows of bookshelves, with books spread out or scrolls on them.
There are also wooden signs on the bookshelf, indicating the boxing skills or sword martial arts. Not only that, but also the level of the skills.
For example, Zhang Yuan discovered the Iron Armor Fist Manual in the fist position of the third level human level.
The boxing manual of Iron Armor Fist is only a few pages thin. In addition to the diagrams, there are also some text annotations. After flipping through it, I feel that it is no different from what I have practiced. The text annotations are not as detailed as Cao Zhengtang's explanation.
Next to the Iron Armor Fist boxing manual are some boxing techniques of the same level, including the boxing techniques spread by Xian Qin Junwu and Zhenfusi, as well as Jianghu boxing techniques.
Read through and see that most of the opening chapters of Jianghu Boxing say something profound, such as "This boxing can conquer mountains and rivers", "With this technique, one can travel thousands of miles", and "It took me a period of practice to understand this technique and pass it on to future generations"...
The martial arts of Junwu and Zhenfusi are not as fancy. They only record that "this method is one of the basic methods of Zhenfusi's twelve martial arts", "in the 31530th year of the Xianqin Dynasty, Han Zhao, the general of Yunxiang, created this fist", etc.Wait for the message.
Zhang Yuan couldn't waste the opportunity he finally got to choose a technique on the human level technique.
He went straight to follow the wooden sign and saw the location of the earth-level technique.
